Maya K: FYI main turned red right after the auto-merge (merge #4521) — gpu-smoke stage failing consistently. https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/2812345678 :confused:
ci-bot: build 2812345678 failed: gpu-smoke (exit code 1) — failing test: test_kv_cache_integration::test_kv_eviction
Leo T: I can take a quick look, but if it's flaky we should try a rerun first. Who owns the merge?@Maya?
Maya K: I merged it, but I didn't run the full smoke matrix. My bad. Please try rerun if helpful.
Sri P: Agree rerun first. If it repros consistently, request bisect. Quick triage checklist: 1) rerun 2) check kernel OOM 3) bisect commits between previous-green..4521
Alex R: If rerun fails, we should hold the deploy and roll back the merge so prod capacity not impacted. Revert PR 4521 is trivial.
Infra Oncall: kicking off rerun now: `ci rerun --build 2812345678 --stages gpu-smoke` — I'll post results in ~3m
ci-bot: rerun queued (rerun id 2812345681)
Infra Oncall: rerun finished — still failing, same test, same stack: `kv_cache.cpp:245 eviction triggered -> cuda alloc failed`
Leo T: OK that's reliable. Can someone bisect? I can start if no objections. cmd I'll run: `git bisect start -- bad=origin/main@4521 good=origin/main@4519` then run smoke harness.
Maya K: please go ahead, Leo. I'm available to revert if bisect points to our change.
Sri P: Logging a short incident note in incidents/ — linking this thread and the CI URL.
Alex R: If bisect isolates to a non-obvious commit, ping me and I'll help debug kernel memory path.
Maya K: thanks all — Leo, please update here with the culprit commit hash or drop a revert PR if it's obviously from #4521.
